idea: Younger Mancunian driver in his late twenties: flat Northern vowels, panic tipping into rage, and the voice cracks on the shout. A Northern accent can't be mistaken for American or for the minister.
script: Two minutes out... Get the fuck out of the way!
tone: A young working-class man in his late twenties from Manchester, with a strong Mancunian accent and flat Northern English vowels. He is an NHS paramedic driving the ambulance, frightened and out of his depth, his breathing ragged. He blurts out the first line to the crew behind him. On the second line he loses it and screams at the cars ahead, his voice straining and cracking at the top. Raw and human, like an urgent British hospital drama. Close microphone, dry, voice only.
